help:
hubcard-lint {version} — offline linter for Hugging Face Hub repo card metadata (unofficial)

Usage: hubcard-lint [paths...] [options]

  paths                 .md files or folders (README.md files are collected, node_modules and .git skipped).
                        Default: ./README.md

Options:
  --type <type>         auto | model | dataset | space (default: auto)
  --format <format>     text | json (default: text)
  --strict              exit 1 on warnings and lint findings too
  --exit-zero           always exit 0 (reports, demos)
  --quiet               print errors only
  --lang <lang>         en | ko (default: HUBCARD_LINT_LANG, then LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES, LANG)
  --list-rules          list rules with level, source and observation date
  --version             print version and rules snapshot
  -h, --help            show this help

Exit codes: 0 = no errors, 1 = errors (or any finding with --strict), 2 = usage error
Severity: error = the Hub rejects the push, warning = the Hub shows a metadata warning, lint = accepted by the Hub but wrong per docs or missing from filters
usage.unexpectedArgument: option "{option}" does not take a value
rules.header: RULE	LEVEL	CARD TYPES	BASIS	OBSERVED	SOURCE
msg.front-matter/missing: no YAML metadata block at the top of the card; add a --- … --- block with at least "license"
msg.yaml/duplicate-key: the same key appears twice (front matter {fmLine}:{fmColumn}); keep only one
msg.yaml/not-mapping: the metadata must be a mapping of key: value pairs, not a list or a single value
msg.yaml/seq-merged-scalar: list item became one string "{value}" because "- " sits on a continuation line; fix the indentation if you meant separate items
msg.license/unknown: license "{value}" is not a Hub license identifier
msg.license/other-needs-name: "license: other" without "license_name"; add license_name (and license_link or a LICENSE file)
msg.language/too-long: language "{value}" ({path}) is longer than 3 characters; use an ISO 639 code such as "en"
msg.pipeline_tag/unknown: pipeline_tag "{value}" is not in the official task list
msg.library_name/unknown: library_name "{value}" is not a known model library; the Hub will not show its code snippet or library filter
msg.library_name/missing: no "library_name"; the Hub does not guess it for new repos, so loading code and the library filter will be missing
msg.datasets/not-string: {path} must be a dataset id string, but it is {got}
msg.base_model/format: base model "{value}" ({path}) is not a model id like "org/name"
msg.base_model_relation/enum: base_model_relation "{value}" must be adapter, merge, quantized or finetune
msg.model-index/required: model-index is missing the required field {path}
msg.model-index/not-list: model-index must be a list of models
msg.task_categories/unknown: task category "{value}" ({path}) is not in the official task list
msg.task_ids/unknown: task id "{value}" ({path}) is not a known sub-task
msg.size_categories/format: size category "{value}" ({path}) is not a Hub size bucket such as "1K<n<10K"
msg.configs/data-files-missing: config "{name}" has neither data_files nor data_dir
msg.space/color: {key} "{value}" is not one of red, yellow, green, blue, indigo, purple, pink, gray
msg.space/app_port-quoted: app_port must be a number, but {got} is a quoted string; remove the quotes
msg.space/app_port: app_port must be a number, but it is {got}
msg.space/suggested_hardware: suggested_hardware "{value}" is not a hardware flavor the Hub accepts
msg.space/sdk: sdk "{value}" is not one of gradio, docker, static
msg.space/sdk-missing: no "sdk"; a Space needs gradio, docker or static
msg.space/sdk-version-missing: "sdk: gradio" without "sdk_version"; pin the Gradio version the Space was tested with
desc.front-matter/missing: README.md has no YAML metadata block (Hub warning)
desc.yaml/syntax: YAML syntax error, same wording as the Hub push error
desc.yaml/not-mapping: Metadata is a list or a scalar instead of a mapping
desc.yaml/seq-merged-scalar: A mis-indented "- b" was merged into the previous list item
desc.license/unknown: license is not in the Hub license table
desc.tags/not-string: tags entry is not a string
desc.pipeline_tag/unknown: pipeline_tag not in the official task list
desc.library_name/unknown: library_name not a known model library
desc.datasets/not-string: datasets entry is not a string (e.g. - null)
desc.base_model/format: base_model entry is not a model id
desc.model-index/required: Required model-index fields (task.type, dataset.type, metrics type/value)
desc.task_categories/unknown: task_categories entry not in the official task list
desc.task_ids/unknown: task_ids entry not a known sub-task
desc.size_categories/format: size_categories entry not a Hub size bucket
desc.configs/data-files-missing: configs entry without data_files or data_dir
desc.space/color: colorFrom/colorTo not one of the 8 Space colors
desc.space/suggested_hardware: suggested_hardware not a Hub hardware flavor
